pf2e-multi-target-checks.unresolved: Couldn't resolve this target (out of range, or no matching defense)

separateRolls.name: Hold: Roll Separately per Target
separateRolls.hint: While held, a Strike, skill action or spell attack with multiple targets makes one full roll per target (e.g. Whirlwind Strike) instead of resolving one roll against all of them. All Strikes use the same multiple attack penalty.
